nisar.verified_from: ISCE3 (the NISAR science processor) cxx/isce3/signal/Crossmul.cpp, develop branch, retrieved 2026-11-14: interferogram = refSlc * conj(secSlc); the flattening term uses phase = 4*pi*range_offset/wavelength and is applied conjugated. With ISCE3's SLC phase convention exp(-j*4*pi*R/wavelength) (measured in isce3-benchmark PR #56), interferogram phase = 4*pi*(R_secondary - R_reference)/wavelength, so positive phase = range increase = motion away from the satellite. Our pair_los_displacement_mm = unwrappedPhase * wavelength / (4*pi), with no sign change, so positive = away.
